Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Resize a lab virtual machine

Body.Content:
One of the great benefits of Azure virtual machines is the ability to change the size of your virtual machine based on the needs for CPU, network, or disk performance.

Lab users can now use this feature inside Azure DevTest Labs. This feature enables users to update the size of their virtual machines according to their needs without having to create a fresh machine every time their requirements change.

To learn more about this feature, go to the team blog.
